limitations: A byte-pattern census, not decoded instructions: the pair 55 48 89 e5 found after the window start can straddle an instruction boundary, so frame_pointer_deferred is a hypothesis checked against the window bytes recorded per row. push_rbp_first means push rbp is the first window instruction (after an optional endbr64) and mov rbp,rsp does not follow it in the window; rbp is then a saved general register, not an established frame pointer. Absence of the pattern does not prove a frameless function: a frame pointer can be established after the window, and code without unwind data has no FDE at all. An FDE extent is the unwind-described range, not a validated function boundary. This census resolves only the RE-002 frame_pointers field; it establishes no other build flag, no component ownership and no equivalence.
